Cleveland Touring Club Wednesday North Chagrin Social Ride

Willoughby, OH · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Cleveland Touring Club Wednesday North Chagrin Social Ride is a road and social group ride in Willoughby, OH. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from North Chagrin Nature Center. About 15–22 miles, social pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cleveland Touring Club Wednesday North Chagrin Social Ride group ride

The social-pace group of the club's Wednesday ride from North Chagrin Reservation, east of Cleveland. 15 to 22 miles. Faster C and Alt-C groups leave from the same lot. Parking on site.
